build_sample_longbench_v2_requests: build a list of DatasetRow objects from LongBench-v2 dataset using a tokenizer and optional context length filter
create_longbenchv2_dataset: create a LongBenchV2Dataset instance from argparse Namespace with dataset path and prompt count parameters
run_longbenchv2_dataset_load: run the LongBenchV2Dataset.load method to generate DatasetRow list from parquet, JSON lines, or HuggingFace dataset
test_format_prompt: test the _format_prompt function to format a LongBench-v2 example into a multiple-choice question prompt
review_longbenchv2_constants: review LONGBENCH_V2_REPO_ID and LONGBENCH_V2_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_LEN constants used for dataset loading
